role_feature_postnatal_name80130332.en: At midnight each day, suffer from an unbearable itching sensation throughout the entire body.

role_feature_postnatal_name80130334.en: One of the Seven Ruinous Destinies. Legend tells of a master cultivator who, afflicted by this curse, laughed without cease for ten years. Unable to bear it any longer, they detonated their energy and ended their own life. This Destiny was later recorded in a secret manual of the Manual Pavilion.

role_feature_postnatal_name80130338.en: Confined to the spot, unable to interact with anyone.

role_feature_postnatal_name80130532.en: Gravely wounded and must rest in the Origin Box. Cannot take any actions.

role_feature_postnatal_name80130534.en: A fragment of the puppet's soul resides within you, allowing her to sense when you're in danger. Though she is a creation of the Upper Realm, her power has its limits. <r>Should you suffer another grievous wound from your enemies, the fragment will shatter and cease to exist.</r>

role_feature_postnatal_tips101.en: You're heavily wounded and on your last breath. You must use the Body Reconstruction Elixir I to reconstruct your body or you'll die.

role_feature_postnatal_tips1014.en: It is a second soul condensed by some secret techniques. However, it is Broken. To reconstruct the body with it, the person most cherished by the soul's owner must use Body Reconstruction Elixir IV to facilitate the process, or the second soul will dissipate.
role_feature_postnatal_tips1014.ch: 利用秘法修炼的第二元魂（残缺）。需要记忆最深刻之人用九转还魂丹帮助才能重塑肉身，否则元魂将会消散。

role_feature_postnatal_tips20003.en: The same token of Cowherd and Madam Weaver, symbolizing the deep affection between you and another person. When he or she encounters deadly threats from other Cultivators, this knot will create a wonderful reaction across space, which may lead you to him/her.
role_feature_postnatal_tips20003.ch: 牛郎织女的同款信物，象征着你与对方深厚的情谊。当对方遭遇其他修仙者的致命威胁时，这个绳结将产生跨越空间的奇妙反应，或许可以将你带到对方的身边。
